decisions.reason: The homepage placement clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the gallery integration decision requires no additional candidate-state change.
Displaying videos together with gallery pictures does not change the source or selection of the gallery photographs.
The gallery video display decision does not affect package or square-footage pricing presentation.
Placing a homepage video beside portfolio photos does not alter where the existing portfolio tiles link.
Integrating videos with pictures does not change the configured hover-animation behavior.
The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already removes the separate videos tab from category_tabs, fully reflecting that videos will appear with the pictures.
The video placement decision does not change the destinations or behavior of homepage navigation buttons.
The source decision concerns portfolio video presentation and does not affect individual-service pricing transparency.
Adding videos alongside pictures changes gallery content presentation but does not alter the existing requirement that viewers can interactively scroll through the gallery.
The gallery and homepage video presentation decision is unrelated to the deferred quote calculator.
Displaying videos with pictures does not change the requirement to use client-supplied images in site sections.
Placing portfolio videos beside homepage portfolio photos does not change the hero image, overlay, or image-emphasis settings.
